Create an original 1536x1024 hand-painted watercolor and fine colored-pencil game scene. Reference 1 is a GEOMETRY/LAYOUT GUIDE only, not the desired visual style: keep its projected object locations. Reference 2 is the accepted game's watercolor/pencil material/lighting style. Reference 3 is the surrounding room for color continuity. Replace the wireframe guide with a warm, elegant, quiet tabletop light-and-shadow craft scene, natural lived-in independent-game illustration, no UI. The camera is a slightly oblique view across a pale wooden desk. A soft window and very restrained leafy shadows/curtain occupy the upper background; no new fantasy landscapes or heavy ornament. Match the accepted pale sage, ivory, honey wood, muted brass, gentle daylight and delicate irregular pencil contours. Do not make it photoreal, glossy 3D, over-saturated or ornate.
EXACT layout on 1536x1024: On the left a small sage-green articulated desk lamp, foot around (281,641), its open lampshade aperture at (281,421), hood extending left of that point and pointing RIGHT slightly downward. It will shine toward the right-hand mirror, not directly at the front paper. At (428,473) a very thin warm wood bookmark lies flat across a slender adjustable brass clip/stand, with its little tassel extending away from the light path, low stand foot around (428,673). Keep this recognizably one long, narrow wood bookmark with brown tassel, no legible lettering. Middle at (686,477) is a small clear square transparency in a minimal wood/brass sliding holder on a short narrow rail, foot about (686,677); its edges follow the guide's little upright parallelogram (rough bounds x674..699 y434..520). At the right back is a round hand mirror on a subtle rear rest: mirror face obliquely seen as the tilted oval in the guide, centred (1091,514), outer bounds approximately x995..1187 y364..664, thin worn brass rim and a short dark honey-wood handle below. Reflection quiet pale gray/cream, no painted landscape. Right FOREGROUND has one thin portrait sheet of translucent tracing paper held in a very light, unobtrusive clip stand, corners exactly about (764,531),(1115,562),(1115,932),(764,901). Keep this paper entirely BLANK, gently warm white, little paper grain, two tiny quiet clips, not another thick wooden picture box. It stands IN FRONT of and naturally obscures the lower-left part of the mirror and handle, as in real depth. A modest green pencil rests to the lower right, tip toward the paper, about (1190,899) to (1400,968), fully visible, with space around it. Keep all essential apparatus and the paper inside generous canvas margins.
The guide's rays, line drawings, dots, blue mirror fill, colored source dot and dark shadow band are ONLY mechanical placeholders: DO NOT paint any rays, shadow silhouettes, window drawing, umbrella, target marks, text, labels, digits, interface, rulers, dials, or control panel. The image is an assembled construction concept that will later be split into stable background and movable props. Paper, mirror and transparency must stay blank so the game itself can calculate and render light and ink. Do not substitute arbitrary placements, duplicate objects, add extra mirrors/books, people, cartoon mascots, flowers, stickers or decoration inside the working area. Gentle tactile picture-book craft, careful edges, spacious coherent composition.
